tasks.short: Keep contact with insurers and agencies

steps.what: Open contacts for insurance carriers and police departments
Maintain contact with those carriers, departments, and other agencies
Ensure protection and compliance with codes and regulations

tasks.design: The manager maintains contact with insurance carriers, fire and police departments, and other agencies to ensure protection and compliance with codes and regulations. {DOCS} opens stored contacts. A missing contact stays blank. The contact and the compliance judgement stay at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager searched for a number and then called.
tasks.enabler_now: A property identifier can open a contact stored earlier.
tasks.still_hard: The call, and judging whether the property complies, stay with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not treat a missing contact as proof of compliance.
tasks.altitude: Compliance stays a judgement. Only finding the contact is shorter.

reach.learn: Which risks the carrier has excluded.

evidence.claim: A stored property identifier can open an agency contact. Judging compliance stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a property to protect and ends when the manager has made contact and judged compliance, or stops.
A contact row has agency name and phone, entered by the manager. A missing phone is left blank.
Opening the contact does not shorten the call or the judgement. No certificate is filed in this task.
unknowns: Which codes apply to each property.
research_questions: How often was the contact missing, so the manager still searched?

already_counted.description: Checking protection and compliance is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: opening a contact adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: contacts are often blank, so the calls are unchanged. High: the contacts open, and the compliance judgement still takes the call. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Confer regularly with community association members
Ensure their needs are being met

tasks.design: The manager confers regularly with community association members to ensure their needs are being met. Nothing is written to {DOCS}. The conference stays at full effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager meets the members and listens.
tasks.enabler_now: No stored survey shortens the conference.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing the members and judging whether needs are being met stay in the room.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not mark a need met if the member says it is not.
tasks.altitude: The conference stays the work. Nothing in it is shortened.

reach.task: Say what they need from the property
reach.learn: Which needs the member says are still open.

evidence.claim: Conferring with association members stays a meeting. No record makes that conversation shorter.

assumptions: The work starts when the members meet and ends when the manager has heard them, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
A later work order, if a need becomes a repair, is a different task.
unknowns: How often the association expects this conference.
research_questions: Which needs did members say were still open after the last conference?

already_counted.description: Conferring with community association members is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the conference adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every conference is still held in person. High: the same conference remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Choose building and maintenance supplies, equipment, or furniture
Review the purchase list before it is sent
Send the accepted purchase for those supplies

tasks.design: The manager purchases building and maintenance supplies, equipment, or furniture. The manager chooses the items and reviews the list. {EMAIL} sends only the accepted purchase. A blank price or quantity stays blank and is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager chose the items, wrote the list, and sent it.
tasks.enabler_now: An accepted list of known items can be sent as written.
tasks.still_hard: Choosing what to buy stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager will not send a line with a blank price.
tasks.altitude: The purchase is sent only after the manager accepts that list. Choosing the items stays theirs.

reach.learn: Which items the supplier cannot provide.

evidence.claim: An accepted purchase list can be sent as written. Choosing the supplies stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with something the building needs and ends when the accepted purchase is sent or the manager stops.
A line has item, quantity, and price, written by the manager from a supplier's stated price. A blank price is left blank and stops that line.
The send uses the list accepted in the review. A later change of price voids that acceptance.
unknowns: Which purchases the owner must approve first.
research_questions: How often did a blank price stop a line?

already_counted.description: Choosing supplies, equipment, or furniture is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a price or quantity before the purchase is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: the list is still chosen by hand, so sending is part of the task only. High: the list is accepted and sent, and choosing the items remains. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep property activity and cost records

steps.what: Total sales, rental usage activity, and operating costs
Review special permits issued and property availability

tasks.design: The manager maintains records of sales, rental or usage activity, special permits issued, maintenance and operating costs, or property availability. {ERP} totals stored lines. A blank amount stays blank and stops the total. The manager reviews the records, and only the accepted version is written.
tasks.previous_blocker: The manager added the lines by hand and retyped the record.
tasks.enabler_now: Posted lines can be totalled. Writing the accepted totals is a copy of known figures.
tasks.still_hard: Judging whether the record is complete stays with the manager.
tasks.human_edge: The manager does not write a total that skipped a blank amount.
tasks.altitude: The record is written only after the manager accepts that version. The lines themselves were entered when the event happened.

reach.task: Use the record for a decision
reach.learn: Which totals the owner does not trust yet.

evidence.claim: Stored activity and cost lines can be totalled into a record. The manager reviews it before the write.

assumptions: The work starts with a period to record and ends when the accepted records are written or the manager stops.
An activity line has property identifier, kind of activity, and amount, entered by the manager when the sale, permit, or cost happened. A blank amount is left blank and is not treated as zero.
The write uses the records accepted in the review. A log that already runs on its own is not counted as the manager's time.
unknowns: Which activities must appear in every period's record.
research_questions: How often did a blank amount stop the total?

already_counted.description: Reviewing permits issued and property availability is already in the manager's step.

incremental.description: Correct a source amount coded to the wrong record before acceptance.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: lines are often blank, so the manager still assembles the record. High: lines are complete, the manager reviews them, and only the accepted records are written. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still inspects sites, meets people, and decides rents, eligibility, and staff matters. A payment, contract, purchase, advertisement, or record is sent or written only after the manager accepts that version.
reach: An owner receives only a budget or a payment list the manager has accepted.
A contractor receives only a bid request or a contract the manager has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when an amount, a date, or a required document is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a send or a write.
Keep site inspections, tenant conversations, and eligibility decisions in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every property has a budget and a record the owner can trust, and the manager still decides the exception.
